in_sanskrit.name: सुयोग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good and योग (yog) meaning union or combination. Suyog thus means a good omen or an auspicious sign.

in_hindi.name: सुयोग
in_hindi.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good and योग (yog) meaning union or combination. Suyog in Hindi is translated to 'shub aurata', which means 'a good omen' or 'a blessing'.

in_tamil.name: சுயோக
in_tamil.long_meaning: சு (su) meaning good and யோக (yog) meaning union or combination. Suyog in Tamil is translated to 'pillai vizhi', which means 'a good omen for a child' or 'a blessing for a child'.

in_telugu.name: శూయోగ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శూద్ద (shoodh) meaning good and యోజనము (yogamu) meaning union or combination. Suyog in Telugu is translated to 'shoodh yogamu', which means 'a good union' or 'a good event'.

in_marathi.name: Suyog
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Union, Agreement, Concord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suyog हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Suyog means 'a union or agreement between two entities, it symbolizes harmony, concord, and unity. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'su' meaning 'good' and 'yuj' meaning 'to unite'. This name is an excellent choice for parents who wish to bestow the blessings of unity and harmony upon their child.

in_bengali.name: Suyog
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Union, Agreement, Concord
in_bengali.long_meaning: Suyog একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Suyog means 'a union or agreement between two entities, it symbolizes harmony, concord, and unity. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'su' meaning 'good' and 'yuj' meaning 'to unite'. This name is an excellent choice for parents who wish to bestow the blessings of unity and harmony upon their child.
